meta.title: Your Mental Health Today
meta.description: A private 500-statement check-in on how you are doing right now, across 25 present-day mental health areas. It is not a diagnostic instrument.

levels.label: Thriving Today
levels.desc: Your responses suggest today has genuinely been a good day across mood, energy, and coping. Notice what has helped and try to carry it into tomorrow.

levels.label: Doing Okay Today
levels.desc: Today has felt broadly steady, with a few areas that may be worth some extra care before the day ends.

levels.label: A Mixed Day
levels.desc: Today has included both supports and strains. Consider what would make the rest of today, or tomorrow morning, a little easier.

levels.label: A Tough Day
levels.desc: Several areas feel difficult today. Consider reaching out to someone you trust or taking a genuine break before the day ends.

levels.label: Struggling Today
levels.desc: Your responses suggest significant strain today. Please consider contacting a trusted person or health professional, especially if this has been going on for more than just today.
